name: ePayco Business Rules
description: Business Rules integration submodule of ePayco: a 'Fetch payment' action, an 'ePayco payment info' variable, and a 'Transaction response' reacts-on event, so site builders can react to ePayco transactions and pull payment data into Business Rules.
project_description: ePayco Business Rules integrates the ePayco project with the Business Rules module. It provides a 'Fetch payment' action that queries ePayco for payment/transaction information (by custom value, path argument, query string, or the transaction-response event argument) and stores it into an 'ePayco payment info' variable, plus a 'Transaction response' reacts-on event driven by ePayco's transaction-response event. Note the info.yml declares core compatibility ^8.7.7 || ^9 only (Business Rules for Drupal 10+ is required for newer core).
